g.text: - Fixed Amount: uses the exact value entered in the rule, e.g. Meal Allowance = 2,000.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Basic Salary, or Gross Salary, e.g. HRA = 20% × Basic Salary.
